Set next to the picturesque Vondelpark, in the heart of the city, the 396-room Amsterdam Marriott is celebrated for its proximity to significant landmarks such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, exclusive shopping, vibrant nightlife and high-end restaurants. The hotel also features 11 flexible meeting and event spaces with natural daylight, including our Grand Ballroom and studios.

Besides this, you also help other departments, like the concierge, valet parking, housekeeping, and assist with technical requests at night.  What makes you the perfect fit?You are strongly hospitality minded, representative and flexible. You like to work in teams, but on the other hand, you can also work alone. You have strong social skills and an eye for detail. But most importantly, you are willing to work at night, and during holidays (Christmas, New Year's Eve, Etc.)To be eligible for this position you…

• Have received ABM / Beveiliger 2 level
• Have a driver's license

• You have a good level of English and Dutch
• Have preferably 2 years' experience within security
